title: Remote Access VPN Incident Response
description: Remote access VPN failures affecting attorney remote work
triggers: VPN connectivity issues for remote users
immediate_actions: Assess impact on remote attorney productivity
Notify IT support team for user assistance
Implement alternative remote access if available
investigation_steps: Check VPN gateway status and logs
Analyze VPN connection patterns and errors
resolution_steps: Restart VPN services following standard procedures
Implement authentication system fixes if needed
Apply VPN configuration changes or rollbacks
Coordinate with VPN vendor for complex issues
verification: Test VPN connectivity from remote locations
Confirm with remote users that VPN is operational
special_considerations: Attorneys rely on VPN for client work and court deadlines
Coordinate with attorneys for minimal disruption to client work
Document any VPN interruptions that may affect client matters
